done_when: The tests that read this repo's workflow pass both with today's settings and with test_place = "local" and checks = ["forge-pr-check"], keeping each test's rule; forge.toml and forge.yml do not change

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - The owner switches this repo to local tests and regenerates its workflow.
The recorded Done-when check runs the tests against the checkout's current settings, where `forge.toml:8` names the `tests` check and the default place is CI. It records no run with `test_place = "local"`, `checks = ["forge-pr-check"]`, and the corresponding generated workflow. The recorded 25 passes can therefore remain green while the local branch here fails. The coordinator's instruction to keep the changes if they pass did not establish a pass for that second configuration. Record the local-mode check as well, without changing the committed settings or workflow.
findings.title: Gate: proof list

why: Tests read this repo's own forge.yml and expect GitHub test groups, so the repo cannot switch to test_place = "local" (owner, 26 Nov 2026: run tests on this machine to avoid another GitHub ban).
